faqs.question: What types of websites does DIGEGAIN build?
faqs.answer: DIGEGAIN specializes in high-performance service business websites, automated booking & appointment systems, product/order catalog platforms, custom business dashboards, portfolio showcases, and AI-enabled digital experiences. We focus on modern systems that directly produce business growth, customer inquiries, and automated workflows.

faqs.question: Does DIGEGAIN build booking and appointment systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We create customized booking solutions for clinics, salons, hotels, consultants, and service providers. These include real-time calendar availability, time-slot selection, automated WhatsApp and email reminders, customer detail collection, and an intuitive administrative scheduling dashboard.

faqs.question: Can DIGEGAIN integrate WhatsApp into my website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. WhatsApp integration is one of our signature features for Kerala and global businesses. We implement floating WhatsApp triggers, automated reservation confirmation links, and pre-formatted order inquiries so customers can start conversations with your sales desk with a single tap.

faqs.question: Can you integrate AI into our website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate practical, business-focused AI capabilities including 24/7 intelligent chat assistants, lead qualification systems, automated FAQ answering, and smart content recommendations. AI is always deployed as a pragmatic tool to enhance your workflow, not as an expensive gimmick.

faqs.question: How long does a website project usually take?
faqs.answer: Most standard service websites and booking portals are designed, developed, tested, and launched in 2 to 4 weeks. Custom enterprise applications, complex multi-user dashboards, and extensive e-commerce catalogs typically take 4 to 8 weeks depending on exact specifications.

faqs.question: Where is DIGEGAIN located and what areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: DIGEGAIN is headquartered in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala. We serve businesses across Kerala (Kochi, Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, Kannur, Kottayam), all across India, and international clients in the GCC, Europe, and North America.
